Closes #3289

Three per-pull-request tests now play their AI games at the 150-node test budget instead of `AI_GATE_BUDGET`. Every assertion is unchanged, and `lethal.rs`'s floor is still `> 20` (the count is 72), with no seeds added.

One of them gained nothing: `r1006006` took 17.6 s after against 16.4 s before, for the reason given below. The others went from 9–65 s to 1–28 s. The workspace-wide `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` the harness runs were not run here; I ran them only for the crates I touched.

## What changed

- **`crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs`**
  - `r1006001` calls `play_at("selfplay-test", 1, 3, "test", TEST_BUDGET)` on both thread pools.
  - `play`'s only caller was `r1006001`, so I deleted it; left in place it would be dead code and fail clippy. `play_at`'s doc now points tests at `TEST_BUDGET`.
- **`crates/tools/src/positions.rs`** (`mod tests`)
  - The old `played` is now `play(n)`, running at `TEST_BUDGET`.
  - A new `played(n)` caches each game in a `OnceLock` array and returns `&'static Played`. Each game is played once however many tests ask for it.
  - Callers pass `game` instead of `&game`, and `r1006003` clones the game it mutates.
  - The `r1171000` comment now says "At the gate budget game 4 reached…".
- **`crates/ai/tests/ai/support.rs`**: a new `pub const TEST_BUDGET` (150 nodes, 40 lethal nodes, 1 determinization, the rest from `AI_GATE_BUDGET`).
- **`crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs`**: the two `AiVsGreedy` games use `TEST_BUDGET`, with a one-line comment saying why. The now-unused `AI_GATE_BUDGET` import is gone.

I printed each game's numbers from `play` and removed the print afterwards. All four games still finish with a result.

# #3289: Patch: three per-pull-request tests play their AI games at the test budget, not the quality gate's
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some tests that run on every pull request play whole games between two full-strength AIs, only to collect game positions or to check that a file comes out the same on one thread and on four. They test nothing about how well the AI plays, yet every game costs as much thinking as a quality-gate game, and CI jobs keep running past their time budget.

Once this is built, those tests play at the small budget other such tests already use. Their checks stay the same and they finish much sooner.

## Why

- `r1006001_the_same_base_and_count_give_byte_identical_lines_on_one_or_four_threads` (`crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs:427-442`) plays 3 games twice through `play`, which plays at `AI_GATE_BUDGET`. `play_at` (`selfplay.rs:266`) already takes a budget.
- `played(n)` (`crates/tools/src/positions.rs:410-412`) plays a gate-budget game. It is called five times (lines 448, 474, 501, 529 and 585), `played(1)` twice.
- `ready_gap_counts_exactly_the_units_legal_actions_lists_an_attack_for_from_either_seat` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs:189-200`) plays two AI-vs-greedy games at `AI_GATE_BUDGET` to collect states.
- `TEST_BUDGET` (`crates/tools/src/arena.rs:336-347`: 150 nodes, 40 lethal nodes, 1 determinization) is "the budget a test decides at when it plays whole games to prove how a game is dealt, seated, replayed or filed, not how well it is played". #3081 already moved three such tests to it.
- Measured on this checkout: `jackioh selfplay --games 3 --seed selfplay-test` at the gate budget took 25.1 s on one thread in a release build with thin LTO. The test profile builds the AI at opt-level 1 and the tools crate unoptimized, so these tests cost more than that.
- CI's `tools duos, selfplay` and `ai slow` groups (`scripts/ci-shards.toml`) run them on every engine, cards or AI change, and #3258 and #3162 were jobs that ran over seven minutes.

## Proposal

- `r1006001` calls `play_at(…, TEST_BUDGET)`.
- `played(n)` plays at `TEST_BUDGET`, each `n` once, cached in a `OnceLock` as `selfplay_records` does.
- `lethal.rs`'s two games play at a test budget. If the coverage floor its comment names then fails, the fix is more seeds, never a lower floor.
- Leave alone the tests whose names claim gate games: `match_.rs`'s b26 and r977000, and `decide.rs`'s r188.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs` and `crates/tools/src/positions.rs`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs`, plus a test-budget constant in the AI crate if the tools' one is out of reach there.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The three tests' assertions are unchanged and pass, and no test is deleted, ignored or loosened.
- [ ] The pull request reports each test's wall time before and after, on the same machine.
- [ ] `lethal.rs`'s coverage floor still holds without being lowered.

## Size and risks

Small, 3 files.

Risks:
- A lower budget falls back more often: R1489000 faults a game that falls back, but at 150 nodes the games filed clean (`arena.rs:340`).
- The positions tests need games long enough to cover their cases, so the builder checks each one's game still reaches what it asserts.
